prefix: The Rev.
title: The Rev. Godfrey Bolles Lee
dates: (1817-1903)
---

Warden of Winchester College 1861-1903.

His obituary in The Times (31 January 1903), 8, notes that he died on the same day as the Rev. James Edwards Sewell, Warden of New College, and that he had married a Miss Crawford, daughter of a Winchester doctor, who predeceased him.
